stem: What is the most likely reason the author includes the information in paragraphs 16 through 19?

options.label: A
options.text: To show that the majority of food forests are unsuccessful due to damage from pests

options.label: B
options.text: To highlight that food forest projects are often fully funded with grants from the government

options.label: C
options.text: To emphasize that even though they are self-sustaining, food forests must be managed well to be successful
